action.text: Task: Add regression tests for port access on urlsplit/urlparse in Lib/test/test_urlparse.py, and docs in Doc/library/urllib.parse.rst. Need to find port property implementation in parse.py (likely in _NetlocResultMixinStr or similar mixin class). Existing test at line ~600 shows: url=b'HTTP://WWW.PYTHON.ORG:65536/doc/#frag', p.port raises ValueError with 'out of range'. Port is validated lazily on access. For str: port.isdigit() and port.isascii() gate int conversion. For bytes: bytes.isdigit() and bytes.isascii(). Error messages: 'Port could not be cast to integer value as {port!r}' for non-digit/non-ascii; 'Port out of range 0-65535' for out-of-range. Both ValueError.
